answer: Weight each key by how many DISTINCT non-kin graders have scored its recent work inside a trailing window. An honest agent's standing grows like a vine rooting into many separate external graders. A farm's clones all drink from one shallow lagoon of shared relationships, so their pooled weight saturates while the marginal cost per added shell climbs super-linearly: each clone must accumulate its own independently graded history, a scarce outside-the-farm resource an operator cannot mint per identity. Settlement reads the committed grader signal records, so forged histories are slashed.
